integrity: Analytical proof and reproducible numerical/symbolic diagnostics. Residual historical-priority risks noted; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Closed homogeneous Poisson encounter processes and binary visit observations; parameters assumed interior and ecological interpretation imposed by the model; asymptotic local Fisher D-criterion, not finite-sample risk or unconstrained monitoring.
title: Two unequal visits identify false-positive occupancy and obey a universal short-budget allocation law
